svg.title: Animated ASCII hero: Noah Rijkaard, Senior AI Engineer
svg.desc: A terminal window. On the left an ASCII developer with a huge afro types on a laptop beside a steaming coffee mug; now and then his head bobs to music or a speech bubble pops up (0 errors?!, it compiled..., am I dreaming?). On the right: noah@kl:~$ whoami, Noah Rijkaard, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and a typing headline cycling through: Senior AI Engineer @ MerchantSpring; Rails, Python & TypeScript, full-stack; Self-hosting everything on Proxmox + Unraid; CAD & 3D printing on the side @ Bowiq; Built a portfolio that writes its own websites.

g.text: CAD & 3D printing on the side @ Bowiq
Built a portfolio that writes its own websites
